name: magnetic-button

frames.best_why: The light button is visibly pulled down and right inside a lit blue dashed field, with the pointer beside it.

tagline: Two buttons tug toward your cursor inside a dashed blue field.
summary: A pair of buttons with a padded hit area; when the pointer enters, the button drifts toward it and a dashed blue field lights up, springing back when the cursor leaves.
appearance: A dark rounded card holds a bold white title, a short grey line and two buttons: a light filled one and a dark outlined one. A dashed blue rectangle with a faint blue wash surrounds whichever button is hovered.
behaviour: Moving the pointer into a button's padded field pulls the button toward the cursor up to a set distance while the dashed outline and blue tint fade in. Leaving lets a spring carry it back to centre.
demo_content: Title 'Magnetic button', a hint about the dashed field, and Get started / Documentation buttons.
search_phrases: playful cta for a landing page
dashed box that highlights on hover
interactive button that leans toward you
use_when: A hero or pricing call to action should feel tactile and invite a little play before the click.
avoid_when: Touch and keyboard users get none of it, and an already small target shifts away as the pointer nears.
customise: Pass any children and set strength, maxDistance and the hit-area className; the spring and the blue highlight colour are fixed in the source.
weight_why: One spring transform updated on pointer move, idle the rest of the time.

a11y.note: The pull happens only on pointer move, and no focus style or reduced-motion check is added to the wrapper.

polish_why: Tactile pull and a clear hover field; the dashed outline is easy to miss at rest.
title: Magnetic Button
